## Attendance

The board met in July 2024. Present were: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, M. Chen. The meeting was chaired by J. Whitfield.

## Performance

The board reviewed performance information for July 2024. A total of 2184 captures was recorded during the month.

The reported grader backlog was 574. The board also noted 41 letter breaches. These figures were recorded for monitoring and will remain under review through the programme’s routine performance process.

The board acknowledged the current position and noted the importance of maintaining oversight of capture volumes, backlog levels and letter breaches.

## Items

No new incidents or changes were reported. The board considered the position unchanged from the information presented and did not identify any additional items requiring escalation at this meeting.

Members were invited to continue raising material changes through the established programme arrangements so that they can be considered at a future meeting.

## Actions

Actions from the meeting will be carried forward to the next meeting. The performance information noted above will continue to be monitored, including 2184 captures, a backlog of 574 and 41 letter breaches.

No additional actions were agreed. The board will review any updated information and consider whether further action is required at the next meeting.
